name: Felino Malbec
serverNotes:
📖 ABOUT: (paulhobbs.com) Premium Mendoza Malbec from legendary winemaker Paul Hobbs. Rated 93 pts by James Suckling! High-altitude vineyard (3,000+ ft) creates concentrated fruit.

🍷 STYLE: Medium to full-bodied Malbec | Bold dark fruit, plum & cocoa | Smooth velvety texture | Soft tannins | Classic Argentine character.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Grilled steaks, ribeye, BBQ, empanadas, chimichurri dishes.

💡 BY THE GLASS: Argentina's signature grape! Great value for this quality level. Also available by the bottle.

name: Duckhorn Merlot
serverNotes:
🏆 ABOUT: (duckhorn.com) Legendary Napa Merlot! Duckhorn made Merlot fashionable in America. Benchmark producer since 1978.

🍷 STYLE: Full-bodied Merlot | Rich, velvety with plum, chocolate & spice | Consistently excellent | Premier American Merlot.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Duck, pork, mushrooms, softer dishes.

🍾 DECANTING: Recommended 30-60 minutes to soften tannins and enhance complexity.

💡 BY THE GLASS: THE benchmark American Merlot. Duckhorn is synonymous with quality Merlot!
